description: This file defines the SUGAR.EmailAddressWidget object, including its properties, methods for managing email addresses in a CRM interface, validation, and form submission logic.

classes.name: SUGAR.EmailAddressWidget
classes.description: Object managing email address input fields, validation, and form submission in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: isIE
methods.description: Detects if the browser is Internet Explorer.

methods.name: prefillEmailAddresses
methods.description: Pre-fills email address fields from provided data.

methods.name: retrieveEmailAddress
methods.description: Retrieves and validates email addresses asynchronously, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for email input fields, triggers retrieval on Enter or Tab.

methods.name: getEventElement
methods.description: Gets the target element from an event.

methods.name: addEmailAddress
methods.description: Adds a new email address input row with associated controls and validation.

methods.name: EmailAddressValidation
methods.description: Adds validation rules for email address fields.

methods.name: removeEmailAddress
methods.description: Removes an email address input row and updates validation and primary flags.

methods.name: fixPrimaryRadioCheckboxValue
methods.description: Ensures primary email radio buttons are correctly linked to email inputs.

methods.name: forceSubmit
methods.description: Submits the form after validation, handling different form contexts.
